mail.label: Cloud Mail (Fairmail)
mail.tracker_dir_note: THIS IS OUR CODE. The gradle project is ac_cloud-mail/ itself (app/, build.gradle, settings.gradle at its root), same shape as aa_cloud-superapp. No upstream clone, no pinned tag, no patch series -- edit the source in place on main. upstream_repo/pinned_tag were removed 2026-08-27; materialize-fork no longer clones anything, it just verifies the tree is there. GPL provenance (FairEmail by M66B, GPL-3.0) lives in README.md, ATTRIBUTION.md, LICENSE and the per-file headers, which is where a licence obligation belongs -- not in a build input.

build._doc: How build-fork builds this fork: gradle task run via the fork's OWN wrapper (FairEmail pins Gradle 9.4.1 / AGP 9.2.1 — never our devShell gradle), glob of the output APK, and signing='keystore_properties' meaning the engine writes keystore.properties at the fork root from the comms keystore (FairEmail's signingConfigs.release reads it natively — zero signing patch).

gradle_props._COMMS_RSS_BASE_doc: SUPER RSS READER default feed root (wg0-only rss-gateway, feed_auth=none). Baked into BuildConfig.COMMS_RSS_BASE; WorkerFeedSync auto-provisions the channel tree from <base>/channels.json on first run — no manual Cloud Feeds dialog needed.

mail.comment: FairEmail. Reuses the EXISTING ac_mail-fairmail tracker clone already used by aa_cloud-superapp's cherry-pick — materialize-fork checks out the pin, never trusts the tracker HEAD. Server: Maddy + Stalwart on oci-mail (imap./smtps. via SNI on :443, jmap.). Do this fork first: pure Java, no RN/Rust, mail server is live.

gh_release._doc: Rolling GH release 'latest' (shared across the ea_cloud-* apps; each contributes a distinctly-named APK asset), overwritten every main push so https://github.com/diegonmarcos/cloud-u-android/releases/latest/download/cloud-comms-mail.apk stays stable. Published by `build.sh gh-release-fork mail` (ship-cloud-mail.yml), which uploads dist/cloud-comms-mail.apk with --clobber. Consumed by aa_cloud-superapp ui.external_apps[cloud-mail].install_apk_url. The immutable timestamped per-build release (RSS notification) is separate and stays --latest=false.

analytics._doc: Consumed by :libs:analytics, which reads THIS file (rootDir) at build time and bakes the values into BuildConfig. Both backends are single-site today, so every app reports into the same site and is told apart by .app — give each app its own site_id once per-app sites exist in Umami/Matomo.
